name: dplus-pullup-tolerance
description: Effective D+ pull-up impedance across all 32 trim codes, checked against the ratified 1.5 kΩ ±5 % row (spec/usb2-device-phy.md §5, §8.2).
claim: spec/usb2-device-phy.md#5-d-pull-up -- nominal 1.5 kΩ, tolerance ±5 % (1.425-1.575 kΩ) across the full PVT envelope, with the trim ladder §5 requires; and spec/usb2-device-phy.md#82-what-gets-measured-and-against-which-section row 'D+ pull-up tolerance'.

best_err_pct.description: spec §5: with the trim ladder set at test, some trim code must land inside 1.425-1.575 kΩ (±5 % of 1.5 kΩ) at every PVT corner. This is the spec row's pass/fail.

r_best_ohm.description: spec §5: the best-code effective pull-up impedance, stated in ohms rather than as an error, so the record shows the value and not only the deviation

r_code0_ohm.description: harness integrity, not a spec row: the untrimmed (all-segments-in) resistance is dominated by unsilicided poly and must visibly move across the process/temperature grid. A flat value would mean the corner .lib sections or .temp never took effect, and every other number in this record would be untrustworthy.
